paragraphs: The 760i xDrive is the flagship of the current G70-generation 7 Series, fitted with a modern V8 engine. The exact engine code for this application requires independent confirmation — the G70's V8 is a new-generation unit, and it should not be assumed to be carried over from the outgoing N63 family without verification. As a G70 variant, this is too recent for an established real-world pattern to exist.
about.boldParagraph: The 760i xDrive is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
